title: No way to decline the optional pick ('You may choose a card')
expected: ven-156-166 is a JSON-set card whose ability comes from the parser. parseLookEffect (packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-draw.ts:90-139) only special-cases the "You may banish ... and play it" tail; "You may choose a card from among them and draw it. Put the rest into your trash." falls through to line 139 `return { amount, from, type: "look" }` with no `optional: true` (verified by dumping getAllCards(): effect is exactly {amount:3,from:"deck",type:"look"}). handle_look (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/look.ts:97) only sets pendingChoice.optional when `visionLike || lookEff.optional`, so the reveal-and-pick choice is non-optional (and onRest defaults to "recycle", not trash, line 53). resolvePendingChoice then rejects accept:false unless choice.optional (game-definition/moves/pending-choice.ts:662) and the enumerator only pushes the {accept:false} decline variant when choice.optional (pending-choice.ts:803-804). Hence only the 3 pickedCardId moves are offered and a param-less/decline call fails 'condition not met'.
observed: Only three resolvePendingChoice moves (one per revealed card) were offered; UI modal 'Choose a card to draw — Play is paused until you choose' had no skip button; executeMove('resolvePendingChoice',{playerId}) without pickedCardId was rejected ('condition not met').

history.note: parser: 'You may choose a card from among them and draw it' now sets optional:true so the look pick is declinable

resolution.note: parser: 'You may choose a card from among them and draw it' now sets optional:true so the look pick is declinable
